description: This file implements the Response class for handling JSON-RPC responses over WebSockets, including methods for retrieving IDs, checking for result or error presence, extracting result/error data, and validating the response structure.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class representing a JSON-RPC response message, providing methods to access response ID, check for result or error, retrieve result/error data, and validate the response.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the response.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result object from the response if present.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response contains an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error object from the response if present.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the response structure and content according to JSON-RPC standards.
